batch_policy: Reference: one real window per call. Compare six windows together and reversed through the unchanged current port. TimesNet's existing eval adapter invokes its forecasting body once per window; do not bypass or replace this adapter. Other ports receive six-window calls directly.

numerical_policy.comparison_rule: abs(observed-reference) <= 64*eps32 + 64*eps32*abs(reference), elementwise; every value finite and every shape exact
numerical_policy.failure_rule: Record every predictor/condition failure; continue the fixed domain without exclusions, backend changes, tolerance tuning or automatic method repair
numerical_policy.raw_relative_scaled_inputs_state_and_sca: exact equality or cryptographic equality; no numerical tolerance
numerical_policy.reason: 64 FP32 machine epsilons allow small CPU accumulation-order differences between singleton and six-window GEMM/encoder operations. This fixed engineering threshold is selected before forwards, is not a statistical margin, and cannot amend the original 1e-7 CPU/GPU gate.

perturbations.future_raw: For each query separately, multiply all four OHLC fields by1.17 and volume by1.31 at dates >= queried outcome, preserving missing values and the seven strictly previous input bars; keep the already frozen train scaler
perturbations.not_claimed: No refit-invariance to changes inside the training cohort; no security sandbox against arbitrary source access; no attribution of general causality from six finite cases
perturbations.targets: Replace every finite development target y by1.37*y+0.0001; do not refit the scaler or pass targets into a model

probe_scope: Tensor entering the current scalar head, after the port's own normalization, layout changes, encoder and any same-window moments; detached diagnostic hooks do not modify tensors
scope: New post hoc implementation audit of real train655/cal53; six fixed available windows per predictor; no Xtest608, general proof, original GPU parity, fitting, scoring or hypothesis tests
